runtime_weight_policy: expand FP16 operands to FP32 registers or tiles on load; do not allocate a persistent 690.118164 MiB FP32 weight mirror

fp32_scratch.purpose: input, then W2/final output after original input is no longer needed
fused QKV, then reused as W1/gated hidden

notes: AdaLN vectors are negligible relative to the declared scratch and may be a small FP32 uniform/storage buffer.
The plan intentionally uses FP32 for every live activation so the W2 and attention-projection overflow cases cannot be silently saturated.
